title: Model European conditional packed lookup
changes: Add a strict, lossless source model for EUR type-5 packed lookup indices 1 through 33, preserving unused bits and original selector arithmetic.
validation: One isolated Windows build and focused Wine test passed source reconstruction, shape and coherent-edit guards, and original descriptor, packed-reader and type-check prefixes for indices 0, 1, 33 and alias 251.
limitations: The model is not yet published or used at runtime; ordinary use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurements.
